tips.mcpFromFile.text.defaultMessage: Got a server as a .json definition or a .zip of its folder? Add MCP Server from File in the MCP view shows what it runs and asks where to turn it on: the selected project, all projects or none yet.
tips.mcpFromFile.text.description: A tip. Add MCP Server from File and the MCP view are names in Hive: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.mcpFromFile.title.defaultMessage: Add an MCP server from a file

tips.mcpPerProject.text.defaultMessage: A workspace MCP server runs only in the projects that turn it on: switch it on in a project's MCP tab, or for all projects in the MCP view. Its tools stay out of the other projects' agents' context.
tips.mcpPerProject.text.description: A tip. The MCP tab and the MCP view are names in Hive: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.mcpPerProject.title.defaultMessage: MCP servers only where they are needed
